name: Carcassonne

categories.label: Score track total before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi tính cuối game
categories.hint: Points from completed roads (1/tile), cities (2/tile + 2/coat of arms) and monasteries (9) scored during play.

categories.label: Incomplete roads: tiles
categories.labelVi: Đường chưa hoàn chỉnh: số ô
categories.hint: 1 point per tile of each incomplete road you win (most meeples). Sum over all such roads.

categories.label: Incomplete cities: tiles
categories.labelVi: Thành chưa hoàn chỉnh: số ô
categories.hint: 1 point per tile of each incomplete city you win. Sum over all such cities.

categories.label: Incomplete cities: coats of arms
categories.labelVi: Thành chưa hoàn chỉnh: huy hiệu
categories.hint: 1 point per coat of arms in each incomplete city you win.

categories.label: Incomplete monasteries: tiles
categories.labelVi: Tu viện chưa hoàn chỉnh: số ô
categories.hint: 1 point for the monastery plus 1 per adjacent tile (max 9).

categories.label: Farms: completed cities touched
categories.labelVi: Nông dân: số thành hoàn chỉnh kề cánh đồng
categories.hint: 3 points per completed city adjacent to each field you win. Count each (field, city) pair once; sum over fields. Farmers are in the supplementary rules but their final scoring is stated in the base rulebook.

tiebreakers.description: The rulebook states no tiebreaker; tied players are co-winners.

notes: family: area-majority. Majority per feature: most meeples take all the points; tied players each score full points. In-play scoring is tracked on the score track (enter its value in trackScore). Final scoring uses half value for incomplete cities and counts incomplete roads/monasteries as during play. Expansions (Inns & Cathedrals, Traders & Builders, Abbot, River, etc.) not modelled.
